articles.title: Firozabad horror: Trader slams toddler to death after mother rejects marriage proposal | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
articles.rephrased_article: A 25-year-old trader, Jitendra, alias Viraj, was arrested by Firozabad police in a gunfight after allegedly killing an 18-month-old boy. The suspect lured the child out of his house on the pretext of buying him a treat and then attacked him on a deserted road before abandoning the body near his home.  Police recovered a country-made pistol and ammunition from Jitendra, who sustained a gunshot wound to his leg during an exchange with officers.

articles.title: Delhi: Woman befriends new mother, flees with her 7-month-old from Delhi's GTB hospital - Delhi News | India Today
articles.rephrased_article: A seven-month-old child was allegedly stolen from GTB Hospital in Delhi on Saturday after his mother, Nazreen, handed him to an unknown woman she had befriended.  Police are investigating the incident and have registered a kidnapping case. The missing infant and the unidentified woman are being sought by authorities.

articles.title: UP man beats 2-year-old daughter, repeatedly throws her into drain; arrested - India Today
articles.rephrased_article: Monu alias Yogendra Singh, a 50-year-old man from Uttar Pradesh, was arrested for allegedly assaulting his two-and-a-half-year-old daughter and attempting to drown her in a drain. The incident occurred on May 30th at around 2:30 pm and was captured on video that circulated on social media. Police launched an investigation after the video surfaced, leading to Singh's arrest. He is facing charges under relevant provisions of law and has been remanded to judicial custody pending further investigation.

articles.title: Villagers Vandalise Trinamool MP's Party Office In Bengal's South 24 Parganas
articles.rephrased_article: TMC MP Bapi Haldar's party office in Mathurapur, South 24 Parganas district was vandalized by local villagers on Sunday. The incident followed allegations that flood relief materials were illegally stored at the office, prompting a mob to break windows and signage. Haldar denied any wrongdoing, claiming the materials were purchased for distribution among locals.  The BJP denied involvement in the vandalism.

articles.title: Police Case Against Ex-Bengal Sports Minister Over Messi Event Mess
articles.rephrased_article: Bidhannagar South Police filed an FIR against former West Bengal Sports Minister Aroop Biswas for alleged extortion and other charges related to chaos during Lionel Messi's 2025 Kolkata football tour. The complaint was filed by Satadru Dutta, the organiser of the Messi GOAT Tour, who accused Biswas of demanding a large number of tickets and threatening to cancel the event if his demands weren't met.  The FIR alleges that Biswas procured 22,000 "complimentary" tickets from Dutta which were subsequently resold on the black market.

articles.title: Argument In Chennai Bar Escalates Into Road Rage, Car Rams 2-Wheeler, Kills Woman
articles.rephrased_article: An altercation at a Chennai bar led to the death of an 18-year-old Sri Lankan refugee, Yancy, after a group of young men allegedly rammed their car into her two-wheeler. The incident resulted in the arrest of three men aged between 19 and 21, identified as Balamurugan, Joshwa, and Kishore Kumar.  Police have sealed the bar for admitting underage patrons and formed a special team to apprehend the remaining suspects.

articles.title: Former ED special director Satyabrata Kumar who probed Nirav Modi, Vijay Mallya, takes VRS | Today News
articles.rephrased_article: Satyabrata Kumar, a former special director of the Enforcement Directorate (ED), has opted for voluntary retirement from government service after nearly 12 years with the agency.  Kumar oversaw high-profile investigations including those involving Nirav Modi, Vijay Mallya, and the Mahadev online betting network. He received approval for voluntary retirement in April and his departure marks the second instance within a year of a senior ED officer leaving government service shortly after exiting the agency. The ED arrested Satinder Singh Bhasin, director of Bhasin Infotech and Infrastructure Pvt Ltd, on charges of money laundering related to alleged cheating of home buyers.

articles.title: Beyond Duty: Keonjhar Police Step In To Light Funeral Pyre Of Youth Disowned By Family | OdishaBytes
articles.rephrased_article: Keonjhar Town Police in Odisha stepped in to cremate a young man whose family disowned his body after he converted from one religion to another following his inter-caste marriage. The police, unable to convince the family to accept the body, sought assistance from Bharasa Parivar, a local social service organization. Volunteers and police personnel transported the body to a crematorium where Anam Mahant, a Police Outpost officer, lit the funeral pyre in accordance with Hindu rituals.

articles.title: Strict action in Nedumangad child murder case: Minister - The Hindu
articles.rephrased_article: Bindhu Krishna, Minister for Women and Child Development, condemned the brutal murder of Arshid, a one-and-a-half-year-old child in Nedumangad, Thiruvananthapuram.  She assured that the government is taking the case with utmost seriousness and will ensure swift and decisive justice. The Director of the Women and Child Development department has been instructed to conduct a comprehensive investigation into the incident, while Ms. Krishna promised severe punishment for the perpetrators.

articles.title: Nedumangad child murder case: crowd attacks accused during evidence collection - The Hindu
articles.rephrased_article: Ashkar, the prime suspect in the death of his one-and-a-half-year-old son Arshid, was brought to the crime scene for evidence collection in Panavoor, Kerala. Enraged local residents assaulted Ashkar as he was being escorted by police. The autopsy revealed 51 injuries on the child's body, including fresh wounds and partially healed scars, confirming that physical trauma caused his death.  The investigation also uncovered a suspected plot to destroy forensic evidence at the couple’s rented house in Karikkuzhy. Amina, Ashkar's first wife, had previously suffered severe domestic abuse after their marriage in 2022.

articles.title: Youth allegedly stabbed to death at Palluruthy - The Hindu
articles.rephrased_article: Shijoy, a 31-year-old man from Palluruthy, was fatally stabbed on Saturday night at Karma Lane. Jenson, one of the three accused, was arrested on Sunday by Palluruthy police. The other two suspects are also from Palluruthy and are painting workers. Police believe an altercation over a modified bike owned by Jenson led to the murder.

articles.title: FIR against man for facilitating transfer of cyber scam funds through his bank account - The Hindu
articles.rephrased_article: Whitefield Cyber Crime Police have registered a case against Murali G. Reddygopal, a 37-year-old resident of Murthinagar Cross, Bengaluru, for allegedly providing his bank account and banking facilities to cybercriminals.  The investigation revealed that the account was being used as a "money mule" to receive and route funds obtained through online scams in various locations across India. The police suspect Reddygopal knowingly provided his banking credentials to facilitate illegal transactions.

articles.title: Inter-State foetal sex determination racket busted in Chittoor; four arrested - The Hindu
articles.rephrased_article: Chittoor district police raided an illegal foetal sex determination racket in Bangarupalem mandal, apprehending four individuals. The operation uncovered the suspects allegedly conducting unlawful prenatal gender tests on pregnant women from neighboring states, charging exorbitant fees and violating the Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (PC-PNDT) Act.  The police confiscated a scanning machine and identified 14 victims. Two suspects remain at large.

articles.title: Attack on ED officials: SFI Thiruvananthapuram district president arrested - The Hindu
articles.rephrased_article: Students’ Federation of India (SFI) district president Vijay Vimal was arrested by Museum police in Thiruvananthapuram for his alleged involvement in the mob attack on Enforcement Directorate (ED) officials during a raid at Pinarayi Vijayan’s residence.  The SFI leadership denies Vimal's involvement, but police claim video evidence proves his role. The arrest brings the total number of individuals arrested to 26 in two related cases.
articles.civic_flag_reason: Attack on law enforcement officials during a raid raises serious concerns about rule of law.

articles.title: More than 700 arrested after riots erupt in France following Paris Saint-Germain’s Champions League triumph | Today News
articles.rephrased_article: French law enforcement detained 780 individuals following violent clashes that erupted across Paris and several other cities on Saturday night. The unrest, sparked by celebrations after Paris Saint-Germain's victory in the Champions League final, resulted in widespread destruction and injuries to police officers.  While most of the celebrations took place peacefully, authorities reported disturbances in 15 cities, with shops vandalized in some areas. Interior Minister Laurent Nunez stated that judicial action has been taken against 277 individuals, including minors, who face charges related to assaulting law enforcement, theft, and property damage.  Despite the chaos, official victory celebrations are scheduled for Sunday at the Champ de Mars near the Eiffel Tower, with authorities vowing a firm response to any further disruptions.

articles.title: Tenant warned civic body, police months before deadly Delhi building collapse: AAP - Delhi News | India Today
articles.rephrased_article: A three-storey commercial building collapsed in Delhi's Mehrauli, killing at least six people. AAP leader Saurabh Bharadwaj alleged that the building had faced repeated complaints about unauthorized construction and safety concerns, but municipal authorities failed to act.  The MCD, which has suspended two engineers and registered an FIR against the building owner, is facing accusations of misleading the court and shielding the builder. The rescue operation is ongoing with teams using heavy machinery and sniffer dogs to search for survivors.
articles.civic_flag_reason: The article reports institutional failure to address safety concerns, leading to fatalities.

articles.title: One-year-old girl kidnapped from Pune railway station area rescued within 16 hours, 3 detained | The Indian Express
articles.rephrased_article: A one-year-old girl was rescued after being abducted from the Pune railway station area on Saturday night. The Pune City Crime Branch and Bundgarden police launched a joint investigation, examining over 65 CCTV cameras and tracking down suspects in Daund. The suspects confessed to the crime and handed over the child, who was found safe. Three suspects were detained for further investigation.

articles.title: Firozabad: Woman Turns Down Proposal, Man Kills Her 1-Year-Old Son, Then An Encounter
articles.rephrased_article: Jitendra Pathak, alias Viraj, was arrested in Uttar Pradesh's Firozabad after fatally assaulting a one-and-a-half-year-old child, Aarav.  He had been accused of repeatedly slamming the child against the ground and fleeing before being apprehended during an encounter with police. The incident occurred after Viraj expressed his desire to marry the child's mother, Rati, who refused due to her existing son. Police recovered a country-made pistol, live cartridges, and spent shells from Viraj.

articles.title: Lucknow Influencer found dead 5 months after marriage, family alleges dowry harassment; husband, in-laws booked - Lucknow News | India Today
articles.rephrased_article: A newlywed social media influencer, Sagar Rajput, was found dead in her Lucknow home on Saturday.  Her family alleges she was murdered for dowry demands and the death was staged as suicide by her husband and five relatives. Police have registered a dowry death case against Rajput and his family members. The victim's body has been sent for post-mortem examination, and police are investigating.

articles.title: Video: Moment South Delhi Building Collapsed Like A House Of Cards
articles.rephrased_article: A multi-storey building in south Delhi's Saket collapsed on Saturday night, killing four and injuring several others. The three-floor building housed a coaching centre, cafes, and offices with ongoing construction work on the upper floor. Police have filed a first information report into the incident, and rescue efforts were conducted by government agencies and local volunteers throughout the night using heavy machinery and sniffer dogs to search for survivors.

articles.title: Rio’s Forever War | Crime | Al Jazeera
articles.rephrased_article: Brazil's police conducted a massive raid on two favelas in Rio de Janeiro on October 28, 2025, targeting leaders of the Red Command drug trafficking group. The operation resulted in over 120 deaths, with bodies left behind and forensic evidence compromised. Fault Lines reports that the case of Douglas de Almeida da Silva, a father shot by police during the raid, raises questions about the officers' account and the broader pattern of police misconduct in Rio.  The raid highlights ongoing challenges in controlling violence within favelas despite repeated operations.

articles.title: One-year-old girl kidnapped from Pune railway station area rescued within 16 hours, 3 detained | The Indian Express
articles.rephrased_article: A one-year-old girl was rescued after being abducted from the Pune railway station area on Saturday night. Police from the Pune City Crime Branch and the Bundgarden police conducted a joint investigation, examining over 65 CCTV cameras and tracking down the suspects in Daund. The three suspects confessed to the crime and returned the child unharmed.  The girl has been reunited with her family.

articles.title: Nigeria's Rabe Abubakar: Retired general abducted with wife in north-west
articles.rephrased_article: Nigerian retired general Maj Gen Rabe Abubakar and his wife were kidnapped by armed men in Katsina state on Saturday while traveling. The army confirmed the abduction, stating efforts are underway to rescue them and apprehend their captors.  The incident highlights ongoing security challenges in north-west Nigeria where criminal gangs known as "bandits" frequently carry out kidnappings for ransom.

articles.title: Old mortar shell recovered in Samba border village, defused safely
articles.rephrased_article: Locals in Gadwal village of Ramgarh border area, Jammu and Kashmir's Samba district found an old mortar shell in a temple well on Saturday.  The police and a bomb disposal squad were called to the scene and safely defused the shell after assessing it as potentially dangerous. No injuries or damage were reported.

articles.title: ‘Hard to recover from trauma’: TV antiques expert decides to close jewellery shop, leave London after hammer attack - The Times of India
articles.rephrased_article: Ian Towning, a renowned celebrity antiques dealer, has closed his iconic Chelsea jewelry emporium after a violent armed robbery in March 2024 left him traumatized. The attack, which involved a hammer and resulted in injuries for both Towning and his security guard, Mark Simmons, led to significant emotional distress and health issues.  The incident was followed by convictions for James Dixon and Thomas Loring, who were responsible for a series of violent robberies across London. Towning, who had operated the business since 1997, attributed the closure to the ongoing trauma and concerns about safety in light of repeated criminal incidents. He also criticized Sadiq Khan's handling of crime in London.

articles.title: ‘No justice, no peace’: Protests erupt in UK after British-born Sikh Vikram Singh's conviction in Henry Nowak murder - The Times of India
articles.sentiment_target: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Constabulary
articles.rephrased_article: Vickrum Singh Digwa, a British-born Sikh, was convicted of murdering 18-year-old Henry Nowak in December 2025.  The case has sparked protests demanding accountability from the Hampshire and Isle of Wight Constabulary over their response to the incident.  Protests were organized by Southampton Patriots, who are calling for the release of bodycam footage, while right-wing activists like Nick Marcel Tenconi, UKIP leader and COO of Turning Point UK, have also joined calls for transparency. The case has become a flashpoint over the legal exemption that allows Sikhs to carry kirpans in public for religious reasons.  Reform UK has proposed abolishing this exemption, but Sikh community representatives argue it unfairly targets their faith.

articles.title: POCSO Act Applies If Minor Trafficked For Commercial Sexual Exploitation: Supreme Court
articles.rephrased_article: The Supreme Court ruled that trafficking children for commercial sexual exploitation can be charged under the POCSO Act and other relevant laws. The court stated that consent of a child victim or adult under coercion is irrelevant, as long as any of the listed "means" like threat, force, or deception are used.  The bench emphasized that victims' awareness of being employed in the sex industry does not exclude them from being victims of trafficking if they were deceived about exploitative conditions. The court also highlighted the importance of rehabilitation for victims and stressed that the legal framework surrounding trafficking cases is complex and varies depending on factors like victim age, methods used by traffickers, and nature of exploitation.
articles.civic_flag_reason: The article highlights a crucial legal development regarding child trafficking and exploitation.

articles.title: Munna Jhingada: Dawood Ibrahim's Right Hand At Centre Of Planning Attacks In India, Chhota Rajan, Chhota Shakeel, Delhi Terror Attack, Mumbai
articles.rephrased_article: Nine terrorists arrested in India are linked to Munna Jhingada, a key handler of terror modules from Pakistan, and Dawood Ibrahim. The Delhi Police Special Cell recovered ammunition and weapons from the suspects, who were planning attacks on nuclear facilities, airports, railway stations, and power plants.  Jhingada, also known as Syed Mudassar Hussain, is a notorious shooter with ties to both Dawood Ibrahim and Chhota Shakeel, and has been accused of numerous crimes in India.

articles.title: Prime Accused In Bakrid Stabbing Of 17-Year-Old Shot Dead In Police Encounter | OdishaBytes
articles.rephrased_article: Asad, the prime accused in the stabbing death of 17-year-old Surya Pratap Chauhan, was shot and killed during a police encounter in Ghaziabad on Saturday.  Police say Asad had allegedly murdered Surya Chauhan on Bakrid and was carrying a reward of Rs 50,000 for his capture. A second individual escaped the scene and is being sought by authorities. The incident occurred after Asad was believed to be planning to collect money from associates in Khoda area before fleeing the city.  The encounter resulted in one police officer being injured but is reported to be stable.

articles.title: Odisha DRDA Spy Cam Case: How Surveillance Footage, Bribe Attempt Exposed 'Spurned Lover' | OdishaBytes
articles.rephrased_article: Sanjay Adhela, a suspended junior revenue assistant at the District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) office in Jagatsinghpur, Odisha, was arrested for installing a hidden spy camera inside the women's washroom.  Adhela reportedly acted out of malice after being rejected by a female colleague and had purchased the camera online. The incident came to light when a woman employee discovered the camera and alerted authorities. Girija Shankar Mallik, Additional Executive Officer, lodged a formal complaint leading to an investigation that included the cyber cell and surveillance footage analysis.  Adhela confessed to installing the camera in March and attempting to bribe officials before his arrest. Police are examining seized devices for potential recordings and sharing of footage.
articles.civic_flag_reason: Abuse of power and violation of privacy are serious concerns.

articles.title: Newlywed Survives 'Suicide Attempt' After Jumping Off Mahanadi Bridge In Odisha's Sonepur | OdishaBytes
articles.rephrased_article: A newlywed woman from Kainphul village attempted suicide by jumping off the Mahanadi Bridge in Sonepur, Odisha. The incident occurred after an argument with her husband during a motorcycle ride.  Local youths and passersby assisted in pulling the woman from the river where she had landed. She was taken to the district headquarters hospital and is reported to be stable. Police are investigating the incident.

articles.title: Four Tourists Detained After Kasol Firing; Police Hunt Accused Shooter, Weapon | OdishaBytes
articles.rephrased_article: A shooting incident in Kasol, Himachal Pradesh, left one local injured after a dispute between tourists and locals escalated. Tourists from Punjab reportedly fired a weapon during a brawl at the Green Valley Hotel, injuring a local who was rushed to the hospital. The incident has sparked concern among visitors and business owners as police are searching for the shooter, Taman, and the firearm used in the attack.

articles.title: 9th Arrest In Assam Fisheries Scam: Former Project Director Apprehended In Odisha | OdishaBytes
articles.rephrased_article: The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption (DVAC) of Assam arrested Padma Kanta Hazarika, a former officer at the Assam Fisheries Development Corporation Ltd (AFDCL), in Puri, Odisha.  Hazarika was apprehended following a multi-district operation by the anti-corruption wing that led to the arrest of eight government officials, including two from the Assam Civil Services (ACS) cadre. The accused is being brought to Guwahati for further legal proceedings.

articles.title: Predator at cricket nets: How a coach weaponised a 7th-grader’s ambitions and her fight for survival - The South First | News, Politics, Sports, Entertainment & Live Updates
articles.rephrased_article: A special court in Thiruvananthapuram sentenced former Trivandrum District Cricket Association coach M Manu to 16 years of rigorous imprisonment for systematically abusing a minor trainee. The verdict, delivered by Fast-Track Special Court Judge Anju Meera Birla, also included provisions for mandatory financial compensation and a ₹24,000 penalty.  The court's decision comes after a sweeping police investigation uncovered a pattern of child exploitation at the Kerala Cricket Association (KCA) headquarters, with four other cases completed. The case exposed how Manu used his position to exploit aspiring athletes from 2012 to 2024 and was further compounded by institutional negligence from the KCA.  The court recognized the survivor's courage in confronting her abuser and breaking free from the cycle of abuse.
articles.civic_flag_reason: Systematic abuse of a minor by a person in a position of power is a serious concern.

articles.title: tribuneindia...Spotlight
articles.rephrased_article: Dasarat Prasad, the Manipur Tourism Director, was shot and killed by two assailants at his office in Imphal. The motive behind the killing remains unclear, but an Assistant Director of the Tourism Department narrowly escaped being harmed.  The Delhi High Court dismissed petitions seeking an independent probe into a 1994 contract awarded to a consortium of companies. The court also ordered the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) to make answer sheets available to students if needed, emphasizing transparency in their evaluation policy. President K.R. Narayanan expressed condolences for the death of former Lok Sabha Deputy Speaker G.G. Swell, who died in Shillong today.

articles.title: Cross-border job scam: 453 Nepali victims repatriated from UP’s Kushinagar after police crackdown | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
articles.rephrased_article: A Nepalian government-led operation rescued 453 migrants from an alleged cross-border job scam in Uttar Pradesh's Kushinagar district. The victims, mostly poor Nepali nationals who spoke only Nepali, were lured to India with promises of skill training and lucrative employment opportunities but were instead cheated out of money and subjected to harassment.  The Nepalian embassy coordinated the operation, which involved police tracing the migrants' rented accommodation and rescuing them from the alleged recruitment network. The suspects are facing criminal charges for cheating and other offenses.

articles.title: Kasol firing: Tourist shoots local youth after parking dispute, four arrested - Himachal Pradesh News | India Today
articles.rephrased_article: A parking dispute in Kasol market escalated into violence when a tourist allegedly shot a local youth, leaving him injured. The incident triggered panic and led to the arrest of four suspects by police who seized the pistol and vehicle used in the shooting.  The viral videos of the incident have drawn widespread attention and outrage, raising concerns about tourist behavior in Himachal Pradesh's popular tourist destination.

articles.title: Cross-border job scam: 453 Nepali victims repatriated from UP’s Kushinagar after police crackdown | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
articles.rephrased_article: Nepal's police conducted a large-scale operation in Kushinagar district, Uttar Pradesh, to rescue 453 Nepali migrants who were allegedly trapped in a job scam. The migrants claimed they were lured with promises of skill training and lucrative employment but were instead defrauded and confined by organizers.  The operation was prompted by reports from the victims' families and social media posts detailing their ordeal. The police arrested nine suspects, including seven Nepalese nationals, and are investigating the full extent of the network. The migrants were repatriated to Nepal through the Sonauli border crossing with assistance from the Nepal embassy.

articles.title: Odisha: Baranga IIC Shunted After Road Blockade Over Custodial Torture Allegations | OdishaBytes
articles.rephrased_article: Following public outrage and allegations of severe custodial torture, Niranjan Behera, the Baranga police station IIC, has been transferred to the Cuttack Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) office.  Biswaranjan Nayak, the Purighat police station IIC, has been given additional charge of Baranga police station. The incident began when Rakesh Behera was detained on May 21 following the discovery of a woman's body and alleged third-degree torture at the Baranga police station.  Rakesh’s family and villagers protested, alleging that he was secretly hospitalized and attempts were made to conceal his condition.

articles.title: 3-month-old baby murdered, body found in Karnal Canal drain, father arrested - The Tribune
articles.rephrased_article: Sonu, a man, has been arrested for allegedly murdering his three-month-old daughter, Divyanshi. The baby's body was found in the Karan Canal drain after police launched a search operation.  The investigation revealed that Sonu strangled the infant and threw her into the canal following a domestic dispute with her mother, Anita, who had been staying at her parents' home due to frequent arguments with him.

articles.title: Delhi murder: Father kills infant daughter, fakes kidnapping claim to cops
articles.rephrased_article: Deepak, a school van driver from Mukundpur in Bhalswa Dairy, Delhi, has been arrested for the murder of an infant he strangled and disposed of in a septic tank.  He initially fabricated a kidnapping story to mislead police but later confessed during interrogation, revealing financial distress as his motive. Surya, his wife, and their elder daughter also fell unconscious after Deepak left the house. Police are investigating whether other family members were involved or if any drugs played a role.

articles.title: ‘Have 1,000+ gunmen to carry out shootings’: Lawrence Bishnoi gang's letter to Canada Police, says report | Today News
articles.rephrased_article: The Canadian police received a letter from the Lawrence Bishnoi gang in August 2025, claiming they have over 1,000 individuals willing to carry out shootings as part of extortion operations targeting the South Asian diaspora. The letter was delivered to a police station in Abbotsford, British Columbia, and prompted an investigation by the Abbotsford Police Department and its internal extortion task force.  The letter details how the Bishnoi gang extorts money from individuals and businesses, often using Indian nationals as shooters.

articles.title: 'Hang my son': Plea of accused's parents shocks Kashmir after 12-year-old’s rape and murder
articles.rephrased_article: In the small village of Galwanpora, Kashmir, a 12-year-old girl was murdered and her family is mourning.  Mudasir Ahmad Mir, a 30-year-old auto driver from the same village, has been arrested for allegedly raping and murdering the girl. The accused's parents have demanded the harshest punishment for their son, shocking the community. This incident has deeply shaken the village, as it is rare for families of accused to demand such harsh punishments in cases of extreme brutality.

articles.title: Paralympic athlete shot dead in Ghaziabad, one held | Delhi News - The Indian Express
articles.rephrased_article: Chirag Tyagi, a Paralympic athlete, was found dead in Ghaziabad on Saturday.  Police arrested Yash Khatik, another paralympic athlete who allegedly shot Tyagi with a pistol after Tyagi filed a complaint about Khatik's document verification. The case is under investigation and police are trying to find other individuals involved.

articles.title: UP Para-Athlete Chirag Tyagi Shot Dead Days After Qualifying For Asian Games, Rival Yash Khatik Arrested
articles.rephrased_article: A 25-year-old para athlete, Chirag Tyagi, was shot dead in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh.  Yash Khatik, also a para athlete and Tyagi's former training partner, has been arrested based on CCTV footage. Police believe that Khatik shot Tyagi in the back after a dispute over document verification, which resulted in Tyagi's disqualification from competition. The motive was professional revenge, according to police.

articles.title: Paris police detain dozens after violence erupts during celebrations of PSG's
articles.rephrased_article: Paris police detained 45 people after celebrations for PSG's Champions League victory turned violent.  Fans, estimated at 20,000 strong, gathered on the Champs-Elysees and set off flares and horns, causing disturbances in various locations. Some vandalized shops and set fires, while others attempted to storm a police station in the 8th Arrondissement. The main ring road surrounding Paris was briefly blocked by a crowd before being dispersed.

articles.title: Puri Police Foil Robbery Plot; Notorious Criminal Injured In Encounter Near Omkareshwar Temple | OdishaBytes
articles.rephrased_article: Police in Odiaha’s Puri responded to credible intelligence about a robbery plot near Shree Setu Road. During a patrol, officers encountered a group of suspicious individuals, leading to an exchange of fire when one suspect, Chandan Bishnu Prasad Jena, attempted to flee on a motorcycle.  Jena sustained a gunshot wound to his leg and was taken to the hospital for treatment. Police are investigating the incident further to identify other members of the gang involved.

articles.title: J&K High Court upholds dismissal of policeman over militant links, reverses single judge verdict
articles.rephrased_article: The High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh upheld the dismissal of a police constable, Ghulam Mohammad Tantray, accused of militant links. The court rejected a 2011 judgment that had quashed his termination from service, finding sufficient grounds for the government's decision to dispense with the departmental inquiry.  The government argued that conducting a regular inquiry would have compromised security interests and exposed witnesses to threats. Mohsin S. Qadri, Senior Additional Advocate General represented the government.

articles.title: Surya Chauhan murder case: accused Asad dies after Ghaziabad police encounter - UP News | India Today
articles.rephrased_article: Ghaziabad Police shot and killed Asad, the prime suspect in the murder of 17-year-old Surya Chauhan, during an attempted interception in Khora.  The encounter followed a tip-off that Asad was planning to collect money from a friend before fleeing the city. A police constable was also injured during the exchange. The second individual accompanying Asad escaped and remains at large.

articles.title: Death toll in Pune hooch tragedy climbs to 15, cops arrest eight; CM promises to 'dismantle entire spurious liquor ecosystem'
articles.rephrased_article: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has ordered a crackdown on the illicit liquor trade following at least 14-15 deaths in Pune due to methanol-laced spurious liquor. The Pune police and Excise authorities suspect the liquor was laced with toxic substances, though the exact cause of death will be confirmed after post-mortem reports are received.  At least three people remain in critical condition. Eight individuals have been arrested, including the bootlegger and illicit liquor joint owner, Yogesh Wankhede.

articles.title: The Bombay House Heist | A second round of murders - Telegraph India
articles.rephrased_article: Sunil Nair, author of "The Bombay House Heist & Other Forgotten True Crime Stories of India," presents a collection of crime cases from across India. While the book features intriguing stories from Bombay and other regions, it lacks comprehensive geographical representation, particularly focusing on small-town India. The chronological order of chapters is also somewhat confusing, raising questions about the selection process. Despite these shortcomings, Nair's meticulous reconstruction of crimes and insightful exploration of social dynamics make "The Bombay House Heist" a compelling read for crime enthusiasts.

articles.title: 4 Pakistan-made grenades recovered as Delhi Police bust ISI–Mumbai underworld module - The Tribune

articles.rephrased_article: Sukesh Chandrasekhar, Leena Maria Paul, and several others were ordered by a court in Patiala House Courts to face charges in a money laundering case linked to the alleged ₹200-crore extortion of Aditi Singh. articles.rephrased_article: The Supreme Court of India strongly condemned the normalization of dowry harassment, questioning why boys marry women only to insult them and their families. articles.rephrased_article: Simranjeet Singh, a Jalandhar-based RTI activist, was fatally shot outside the gate of Lovely Professional University in Phagwara. Singh had been filing petitions against various individuals and organizations for over a decade. A .32 bore pistol and a .12 bore rifle were recovered from a Fortuner parked near the crime scene. articles.title: Well-Known Educationists Arrested For Plotting Lawyer's Murder In Hyderabad | OdishaBytes
articles.rephrased_article: Mujahid Alam Khan and his father Mahaboob Alam Khan, owners of educational institutions in Hyderabad, have been arrested for the murder of senior advocate Khaja Moizuddin. articles.title: 8 Held After Violent Clash Inside Police Station In Odisha's Baripada | OdishaBytes
articles.rephrased_article: Baripada Town police responded to a violent clash between two groups of youths at the police station on Friday evening. Police sources said that the clash stemmed from an argument between youths from Baripada and Dhanpur areas over a car ride.

articles.title: Uttar Pradesh man repeatedly slams toddler to ground, kills him to marry child’s mother - India Today
articles.rephrased_article: A man, Viraj, has been accused of killing a one-and-a-half-year-old boy named Aarav in Uttar Pradesh's Firozabad.  Viraj, who allegedly wanted to marry the child's mother, Rati, is suspected of repeatedly slamming the toddler onto the ground after taking him from his aunt's house. articles.title: Reshuffle in Udhampur Police, SHOs, officers transferred
articles.rephrased_article: District Police Udhampur has ordered the transfer and posting of several officers with immediate effect. Inspector Purshotam Kumar was transferred from Rehmbal to Ramnagar, while Inspector Nishant Gupta moved from DPL Udhampur to Chenani.  Inspector Parvez Sajad, currently at DPL Udhampur, will assume charge as SHO of Udhampur after the relieving of the current officer, Abhijeet Sirohi. articles.title: Fake Cockroach Janta Party App Spreading Malware, Cyber Security Firm Warns | OdishaBytes
articles.rephrased_article: TraceX Labs, a Mumbai-based cybersecurity firm, has warned of a fake Android app mimicking the popular satirical Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) that steals personal information. The report, published on May 22nd, reveals the app requests numerous permissions and connects to suspicious websites after installation.  Experts say criminals are exploiting meme culture and political trends to distribute this spyware through unofficial APK links, particularly targeting younger users.  The researchers urged users not to download APK files from unofficial sources and asked Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the CJP platform, to publicly confirm the app's unrelated status.

articles.title: Indian Man Paid Traffickers To Assault Minor In US; Sentenced To 10 Years | OdishaBytes

articles.rephrased_article: Pallegama Hemarathana, a senior Sri Lankan monk, has been suspended from his duties after being accused of sexually abusing an 11-year-old girl in 2022. Hemarathana was detained at a private hospital in Colombo while awaiting legal proceedings. articles.title: NEET paper leak: Court extends Hawaldar's CBI custody by two days; remands Mandhare to judicial custody - The Hindu
articles.rephrased_article: The CBI extended the custody of accused Manisha Sanjay Hawaldar by two more days and remanded another accused, Manisha Mandhare, to judicial custody in the alleged NEET-UG 2026 paper leak case.  Special Judge Ajay Gupta heard arguments from both sides before making his decision. The court also issued notice to the CBI on the bail application filed by another accused, Manisha Waghmare. The case is part of a wider investigation into alleged irregularities in the NEET-UG examination and a paper leak network.

articles.title: Rigorous imprisonment for cricket coach for sexually abusing minor - The Hindu
articles.rephrased_article: A 40-year-old cricket coach, Manu M., was sentenced to 16 years in prison for sexually abusing a girl trainee at his coaching center. The Special Public Prosecutor R.S. Vijay Mohan appeared for the Prosecution, who argued that the abuse occurred in the gym of the center and the victim feared career destruction if she reported it.  The accused has been ordered to pay a fine of ₹24,000 and will serve five years before completing his sentence.

articles.rephrased_article: A United Airlines flight from Chicago to Minneapolis was diverted to Madison, Wisconsin on Friday night after an unruly passenger attempted to breach the cockpit. The flight continued its journey to Minneapolis, landing early Saturday morning with no reported injuries among passengers or crew.

articles.title: Meet ICE agent Christian Castro, arrested in Texas for shooting at a Venezuelan in Minneapolis and lying about it - The Times of India
articles.rephrased_article: ICE agent Christian Castro has been arrested for shooting Julio Cesar Sosa-Celis, a Venezuelan migrant, during an incident in Minneapolis on January 14th.
